settings.design.glass_dark.name: Liquid Glass · Dark

settings.design.contrast_dark.name: High contrast · Dark

settings.design.minimal_light.name: Minimal · Light

settings.design.minimal_dark.name: Minimal · Dark
settings.design.minimal_dark.note: The same grays on charcoal; the more urgent, the brighter.
settings.design.pixel.name: Pixel · block colors
settings.design.pixel.note: Blue, yellow, and pink on black: tile headers become color fields, with blocky accent bars and hard pixel frames around thumbnails.
settings.background_note: Colors only the background. The window surface connects both layers without a shadow. A solid color disables gradients.
settings.design_note: The design combines surfaces, colors, and material effects. The header switch changes between light and dark within the selected design.
settings.goal_capacity_note: The daily goal counts completed tasks. Daily capacity is a personal comparison value for estimated effort—not time tracking or a workload rating; 0 shows totals without comparison. Personal settings and daily counts are stored in the selected data location; they are not part of a task backup.
